create_vasp_static_inputs: create VASP input files for an OMat24 PBE static calculation using OMat24StaticSet
create_vasp_relaxation_inputs: create VASP input files for an OMat24 PBE relaxation calculation using OMat24RelaxSet
create_vasp_aimd_inputs: create VASP input files for an OMat24 AIMD calculation using OMat24AIMDSet with nvt or npt ensemble
review_aimd_thermostat_config: review the OMat24AIMDSet incar_updates property to check nose or langevin thermostat INCAR settings
review_relaxation_incar_updates: review the OMat24RelaxSet incar_updates property to check IBRION NSW and ISIF relaxation settings
